title: Bid Manager (AI Solution)
description:
**Job Description:**

Bid Manager – Purple Fabric (Enterprise AI)

**Company:**
Intellect Design Arena Ltd.

**Business Unit:**
Purple Fabric

**Location:**
Chennai, India

**Experience:**
8–14 years

**Mode of Work:**
Work From Office (WFO) – 5 days a week

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented
**Bid Manager**
to lead end-to-end bid management and proposal development for Purple Fabric, Intellect Design Arena’s enterprise AI platform. The role will involve managing RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, tenders, and customer proposals while ensuring timely, accurate, compliant, and compelling submissions.

The ideal candidate will work closely with Sales, Presales, Solution Architects, Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, and senior leadership to develop differentiated proposals that articulate Purple Fabric’s value proposition, technical capabilities, business benefits, and commercial offerings.

A strong understanding of enterprise technology solutions, cloud platforms, AI/GenAI concepts, and complex B2B sales cycles will be essential to succeed in this role.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Bid Management**

* Own the complete bid lifecycle, from opportunity qualification and RFP/RFI/RFQ receipt through submission, clarification, and final handover.
* Analyse tender documents and customer requirements to identify eligibility criteria, mandatory requirements, submission guidelines, evaluation parameters, and contractual obligations.
* Develop bid plans, timelines, responsibility matrices, and compliance checklists to ensure submissions meet customer deadlines.
* Coordinate internal stakeholders to collect, review, validate, and consolidate technical, commercial, legal, and business inputs.
* Manage multiple bids simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, quality, and consistency.

**2. Proposal Development & Response Management**

* Lead the preparation, review, and submission of high-quality proposals, RFP responses, RFIs, RFQs, tenders, capability statements, and presentations.
* Translate complex technical and business inputs into clear, structured, customer-focused proposal responses.
* Develop executive summaries, solution narratives, value propositions, differentiators, implementation approaches, and customer benefit statements.
* Maintain a central repository of approved responses, case studies, product collateral, standard answers, and reusable proposal content.
* Ensure all submissions are complete, compliant, compelling, and aligned with the customer's requirements.

**3. AI & Purple Fabric Solution Understanding**

* Develop a working understanding of Purple Fabric and its enterprise AI capabilities to accurately position the platform in customer proposals.
* Understand key concepts such as Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI orchestration, enterprise knowledge integration, and AI governance.
* Collaborate with Presales and Solution Architects to develop technically accurate responses to architecture, integration, security, scalability, deployment, and implementation questions.
* Articulate the business value of enterprise AI solutions, including workflow automation, intelligent decision support, operational efficiency, and responsible AI adoption.
* Ensure technical claims, product capabilities, implementation commitments, and solution differentiators are validated by the relevant subject matter experts.

**4. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Act as the central point of coordination for bid-related activities across Sales, Presales, Solution Architecture, Product, Engineering, Legal, Finance, Delivery, and leadership teams.
* Conduct bid kick-off meetings, progress reviews, solution review sessions, and submission-readiness checks.
* Track pending inputs, resolve dependencies, escalate risks, and ensure timely stakeholder sign-offs.
* Coordinate with subject matter experts to address customer queries, technical clarifications, compliance requirements, and proposal revisions.
* Facilitate smooth handover of awarded opportunities to the relevant delivery and implementation teams.

**5. Commercial, Risk & Compliance Management**

* Coordinate commercial proposal preparation, pricing inputs, cost assumptions, and financial approvals with Finance and Sales teams.
* Review contractual terms, service-level requirements, delivery commitments, payment terms, and risk-related clauses in coordination with Legal and relevant stakeholders.
* Maintain bid compliance matrices and ensure adherence to customer submission requirements and internal approval processes.
* Identify bid risks, gaps, dependencies, and non-compliance issues early, escalating them to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Maintain confidentiality and ensure the integrity of customer and company information throughout the bid process.

**6. Bid Strategy, Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Support bid/no-bid assessments based on opportunity fit, eligibility, strategic value, competitive positioning, and resource availability.
* Work with Sales and Presales teams to identify customer priorities, strengthen win themes, and improve proposal differentiation.
* Track bid progress, submission timelines, stakeholder dependencies, outcomes, and lessons learned.
* Analyse bid performance and recommend improvements to response quality, turnaround time, content reuse, and process efficiency.
* Drive standardisation and automation of bid processes, templates, response libraries, and reporting mechanisms.

**Mandatory Skills & Experience**

* 8–14 years of experience in bid management, proposal management, RFP management, tender management, or presales operations within enterprise technology, IT services, SaaS, or software product organisations.
* Proven experience independently managing complex RFP/RFI/RFQ responses and end-to-end proposal submissions.
* Strong experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and managing multiple time-sensitive bids.
* Excellent proposal writing, editing, documentation, presentation, and compliance management skills.
* Ability to understand technical solution inputs and translate them into clear, customer-centric business narratives.
* Working knowledge of enterprise technology solutions, cloud platforms, software products, and enterprise integrations.
* Strong project management skills, including planning, tracking, risk identification, escalation, and deadline management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and collaboration tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at different organisational levels.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI, data platforms, automation, or enterprise digital transformation solutions.
* Experience working with banking, financial services, payments, lending, fraud, risk, or other regulated-industry customers.
* Experience in enterprise SaaS or product-led organisations with complex solution proposals and commercial models.
* Familiarity with proposal automation tools, content repositories, CRM platforms, and bid tracking systems.
* Experience supporting international bids, large enterprise deals, and multi-stakeholder sales cycles.
* Understanding of information security questionnaires, vendor assessments, compliance documentation, and enterprise procurement processes.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong ownership and accountability for bid outcomes.
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to submission quality.
* Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, and coordination skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities.
* Structured thinking and strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Commercial awareness and customer-centric proposal development.
* Ability to learn complex technology offerings and communicate their business value effectively.

**Key Success Metrics**

* On-time submission rate for bids and proposals.
* Compliance and completeness of submitted responses.
* Proposal quality and stakeholder satisfaction.
* Bid turnaround time and adherence to internal review milestones.
* Effectiveness of reusable content and proposal standardisation.
* Reduction in errors, omissions, and last-minute escalations.
* Contribution to bid win rates through strong proposal quality and differentiation.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is an experienced bid professional who can independently drive complex enterprise technology proposals from initiation to submission. They should be comfortable coordinating senior stakeholders, working with technical subject matter experts, managing commercial and compliance requirements, and communicating the value of enterprise AI solutions.

Direct AI expertise is beneficial, but the candidate must demonstrate the ability to understand complex technology offerings quickly and convert technical inputs into compelling, accurate, and commercially aligned proposals.

title: Cyber - Data Protection/CASB - Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
As a Consultant in Deloitte’s Cyber practice, you will help clients strengthen data protection capabilities across strategy, design, and implementation efforts. You will support the delivery of data protection solutions that address security, privacy, and regulatory requirements while helping organizations operate with greater confidence in a changing risk landscape. This role offers the opportunity to work across assessments, solution design, deployment, integration, and client enablement in complex enterprise environments.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Consultant - Data Protection on the Data and Digital Trust team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Assess client data protection environments, perform gap analyses, and support the development of remediation recommendations aligned to business and security requirements.
* Contribute to the design of data protection solutions, including technical requirements, high-level design, low-level design, and evaluation of technologies through proof-of-concept activities.
* Deploy, configure, and support data protection technologies across enterprise environments, including migrations, upgrades, high-availability configurations, and platform integrations.
* Develop detection use cases, workflows, and supporting documentation to help clients operationalize and sustain data protection capabilities.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, client stakeholders, and third-party vendors to deliver implementation activities, knowledge transfer, and project documentation.

**The team**
Data and Digital Trust practice is primarily focused on helping our clients to do effective utilization of data while safeguarding privacy and security. title: Commercial Manager, Life of Mine Solutions
description:
Do you want to make a difference in the world and contribute to a sustainable future?
  
  
We believe we can develop the technology and gain the know-how to make a difference. It’s a big responsibility, and we are committed to making an impactful positive change. We need your skills, curiosity, and drive for change to fulfil our goal. Together, we enable our customers to produce the materials and technology needed for a better future.
  
  
**Commercial Strategy & Deal Structuring**

* Outcome-based models: Build and price lifecycle agreements cost-per-tonne, take-or-pay, performance bonus and penalty structures, availability and throughput commitments.
* Indexing & term: Set multi-year index mechanics and term structures that protect FLS margin without. Define what good looks like before we commit externally.
* Consignment & ownership: Structure equipment ownership, consignment parts, and inventory models that the customer and FLS can both stand behind.
* Go/no-go discipline: Apply a clear deal evaluation framework. To advise whether we walk away from deals we cannot deliver or cannot price with confidence.

**Bid, Negotiation & Contract**

* Commercial offers: Lead the build of commercial proposals and pricing. Make sure pricing transparency, KPI definitions, and wear thresholds are defined and defensible, not left open.
* Negotiation: Run commercial negotiation with the customer, holding the line on the points that carry real risk and conceding where it does not.
* Contract integrity: Work with legal to close performance language gaps, per-KPI cap contradictions, and definition risk before signature, not after a dispute.
* One FLS: Make sure product, service, supply chain, digital, and execution are aligned on the commitment before it goes to the customer.

**Execution Readiness & Delivery Alignment**

* Operational truth: Logically test every commercial model against operational reality. A model that ignores site conditions is a future loss.
* Handover: Hand agreements to the delivery teams with the commercial logic, obligations, and risk points named clearly. Nothing implied.
* Performance tracking: Define how each agreement's performance should be measured and reported, so bonus / penalty mechanics for example are based on agreed data, not argument.

**Pipeline, Reporting & Governance**

* Support and maintain a structured commercial pipeline from opportunity through to signed agreement, with clear ownership at each stage for the sales regions you are working with
* Report deal status, margin, and commercial risk to leadership with the call a action and owner named, not just an observation.
* Maintain commercial templates and pricing tools so the team works from a consistent, disciplined base.

**Commercial Tools, Estimating & Standards**

* Commercial tooling: Support the development and ongoing improvement of the commercial tools the team relies on pricing models, offer templates, deal evaluation and go / no-go frameworks. Keep them practical and used, not shelfware.
* Estimating tools: Support the build and maintenance of estimating tools and cost models, Maintenance reference documents so estimators price lifecycle scope from a consistent, defensible base and the assumptions behind a number are clear.
* Commercial & legal guidelines: Work with legal to develop and maintain commercial and legal guidelines for long-term agreements: term and indexation mechanics, KPI and wear-threshold definitions, liability and cap structures, bonus / penalty language. Give the team a clear standard to work from before negotiation, not after a dispute.
* Equipment-specific packages: Develop repeatable, equipment-specific commercial packages for the core FLS product lines, so a lifecycle offer for a given asset starts from a proven template rather than a blank page.
* Version control & ownership: Own version control on tools, templates, and guidelines so the team works from one current source, with changes named and dated.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships**

* Socialize deals, strategic or commercial approach with regional leadership, sales teams, product ownership
* Engage mining operators, internal product, and regional operations to identify and qualify lifecycle opportunities worth pursuing.
* Represent FLS in commercial discussions, performance reviews, and customer planning sessions over the life of the agreement.
* Run competitive intelligence on rival lifecycle and performance-based offers to keep FLS's commercial position sharp.

**Team Support & Mentorship**

* Coach estimators GBC and commercial team members on deal structuring, pricing discipline, and the go/no-go framework.
* Build commercial capability across the team so quality does not depend on a single person.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Win rate on lifecycle deals: Percentage of qualified opportunities converted to signed agreements.
* Margin integrity: Delivered margin against committed margin across the active agreement portfolio.
* Cycle time: Average time from qualified opportunity to signed agreement.
* Execution alignment: Percentage of signed deals delivered without commercial dispute or unplanned concession.

**Knowledge, Skills & Abilities**

* Deep understanding of outcome-based commercial models in mining - cost-per-tonne, take-or-pay, consignment, bonus/penalty mechanics.
* Strong grasp of fixed plant and lifecycle equipment economics: availability, throughput, wear life, repair and renewal.
* Commercial negotiation and contract construction, including working with legal on performance language and risk.
* Ability to connect commercial structure to operational delivery - commercial models built on operational truth, not optimism.
* Clear, direct written and verbal communication, including presenting to senior leaders and customers and holding a position under challenge.
* Strong commercial judgment and the discipline to walk away from a deal that does not hold up.
* Comfort working across product, service, supply chain, digital, and execution to deliver one FLS to the customer.

**Education & Experience**

* Work experience: Minimum 10 years in mining, industrial services, or capital equipment, with a strong record in commercial deal structuring and negotiation.
* Demonstrated experience building and closing multi-year, outcome-based or performance contracts with measurable commercial results.
* Experience leading and developing commercial team members, including geographically dispersed teams.
* Education: Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

**Special Requirements**

* Ability to travel approximately 30 percent of the time, including internationally to mine sites and customer locations.
* Valid driver's license and passport.

**Core Competencies**

* Business acumen: Clear grasp of mining industry trends, risk, and market dynamics that drive FLS's lifecycle business internationally.
* Drive for results: Takes accountability for the commercial outcome and success of the deals owned.
* Influence and persuade: Convinces customers and internal stakeholders to align on a course of action; holds a position when challenged.
* Decision making: Takes personal responsibility for commercial decisions and their impact, including when data is incomplete.
* Critical thinking: Structured analysis of commercial and operational risk to reach a defensible position.
* Continuous improvement: Challenges current commercial process to sharpen FLS's lifecycle position.
* Mentor and coach: Build commercial capability in others through direct, supportive feedback.
* Think strategically: Connects individual deals to the broader shift from product selling to lifecycle accountability.

Leveraging the strength, scope and expertise of our global product network, IMM is positioned as an essential partner to large and mid-market enterprises seeking to maximise their potential internationally, offering streamlined business access to HSBC’s international network and broad range of market leading banking products and services.

The products on offer to these clients include working capital finance, term lending including external commercial borrowing, structured trade solution, transaction banking/ payment solutions, treasury solutions, overseas banking solutions besides capital market and investment banking proposition.

* Ensure that positive customer relationships is fostered and increase visibility in the marketplace

* Possess strong credit skills to ensure quality of the credit is maintained across existing portfolio and new acquisitions
* Possess ability to analyze financial statements, cash flows, industries, trade and Working Capital cycles, etc

* Be well versed with related regulatory policies, guidelines etc

**Qualifications**

* CA/MBA from reputed institution
* Minimum experience of 8-10 years in Banking and 4-5 years as a relationship manager in similar role.

**Additional Notes**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required

title: Condition Monitoring Advisor-1
description:
****Career Area:****
Product Support
  
  
****Job Description:****
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
Our condition monitoring teams use their knowledge, skills, and abilities to interpret the 5 elements of condition monitoring (fluid analysis, equipment inspections, electronic data, repair history, and site conditions) and provides meaningful insights as to what is happening on the equipment. In this role, you will be responsible for providing Caterpillar dealers with relevant recommendations to generate high quality sales leads and help customers manage their business more effectively. This will improve customer loyalty, increase enterprise market share, and grow parts and service sales, while reducing the customer's costs through equipment management efficiency.
  
  
****Job Responsibilities And Duties:****

* Aggregate and correlate the five elements of condition monitoring (where all are available) to provide meaningful insights as to what is happening on the equipment.
* Maintain working knowledge for each of the condition monitoring five elements with subject matter expertise in at least 2 elements.
* Participates in ongoing meetings with Caterpillar dealers and subject matter experts to gain knowledge and insights to increase accuracy of the data analysis and quality of recommendations/leads.
* Provide information for equipment management lead tracking and resolution.
* Assists with Preparing reports regularly to be distributed to Caterpillar dealers detailing financial outcomes and key CM KPIs for CMA recommendations.
* Communicate verbal recommendations as required Caterpillar dealers.
* Build collaborative relationships & act as a consultant with equipment management personnel.

****Basic Qualifications:****

* Experience in the product support and/or engineering fields.
* A college or university degree, technical certification, or equivalent experience.
* Demonstrated experience in condition(health) monitoring.
* Experience of using multiple software/business systems to gather data.
* Proficient in MS office with strong emphasis on MS excel or other analytics tools.
* Performed data analysis and correlation on sets of data.
* Able to deduce and draw conclusions from the analysed data.
* Sound technical ability in servicing/repair of construction equipment, diagnostics tools, data analysis to aide fault finding.

**Skill Descriptors**
**Customer Focus:**
Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Communicates the importance of customer needs/expectations and commits to resolving them.

**Data Gathering & Analysis:**
Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Follows proper data gathering and analysis processes and policies.
* Reports problems that arise in the data collection process.

**Decision Making and Critical Thinking:**
Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
  
  
**Level Basic Understanding:**

* Explains characteristics and steps in an effective decision-making process.

**Effective Communications:**
Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
* Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.

**Problem Solving:**
Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
* Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.

**Relationship Management:**
Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.
  
  
**Level Working Knowledge:**

* Provides prompt and effective responses to client requests and interactions.
* Monitors client satisfaction levels on a regular basis.

****Additional Info:****
This position will require travelling about 30% of the time.
  
  
This position requires working onsite five days a week.
  
  
Relocation is available for this position.
  
  
Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
****Posting Dates:****
October 27, 2026 - November 9, 2026
  
  
Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: Subject Matter Expert – EPC Supply Chain
description: Subject Matter Expert – EPC Supply Chain & Procurement (elsAI Product Team) Product: elsAI (elsai.ai) – OptiSol’s Enterprise AI Agent Platform Experience: Typically 5–8 years in Supply Chain / Procurement, with strong EPC exposure Location: Chennai Engagement: Full-time / Contract About elsAI elsAI is OptiSol’s enterprise AI agent platform. It works alongside the systems an enterprise already uses, helping business teams execute workflows with governance, human review, evidence-backed recommendations, and an audit trail. The platform can be deployed in the cloud, a customer VPC, or on-premises where data residency requirements apply. We are expanding elsAI’s capabilities in Supply Chain & Procurement and are looking for an experienced EPC procurement professional to bring deep domain expertise into our product development journey. Role Overview We are looking for a Supply Chain & Procurement Subject Matter Expert with strong EPC industry experience to work closely with the elsAI Product team in shaping AI-enabled procurement solutions. Having delivered multiple enterprise procurement engagements across manufacturing, metals, EPC, aerospace, and process industries, we are looking to deepen our understanding of complex, project-driven procurement environments. This role is suited to someone who has hands-on experience managing high-value, multi-year procurement cycles involving long-lead equipment and materials, subcontract packages, tendering, techno-commercial evaluations, supplier negotiations, contract management, expediting, inspections, claims, and variation orders. The ideal candidate will have worked as a Procurement Leader, Project Procurement Manager, Supply Chain Leader, Materials Manager, or another relevant functional expert in shipbuilding and shipyards, aerospace and defence, power plants, heavy engineering, or large infrastructure projects. You will serve as the domain authority within the elsAI Product team, bringing real-world procurement knowledge into product discovery, workflow design, requirements definition, and product validation. Working with Product Managers, Engineering, and customer-facing teams, you will translate complex procurement processes and business challenges into practical use cases, product requirements, business rules, and acceptance criteria. Your expertise will help identify where AI agents can improve procurement operations, distinguish tasks suitable for automation from those requiring human approval, and ensure that the resulting product capabilities reflect real enterprise requirements. Key Responsibilities 1. EPC Procurement & Supply Chain Expertise Map end-to-end project procurement workflows, from demand and material planning through vendor qualification, RFQ/RFP, bid evaluation, negotiation, purchase orders, expediting, delivery, inspection, goods receipt, invoice matching, and close-out. Explain procurement practices across shipbuilding/shipyards, aerospace and defence, power plants, heavy engineering, and large infrastructure projects. Identify project-critical materials, long-lead items, BOM/BOQ requirements, technical specifications, approved substitutions, quality documentation, and delivery dependencies. Bring practical knowledge of project schedules, budget controls, supplier delays, change orders, claims, and coordination across engineering, planning, stores, finance, and project teams. Share real-world examples of procurement challenges, exceptions, and decisions to help the Product team understand actual user needs. 2. Work Closely with the elsAI Product Team Collaborate directly with Product Managers to translate procurement challenges into product use cases, workflow maps, functional requirements, user stories, business rules, and acceptance criteria. Participate in requirement-gathering sessions, customer discussions, and domain workshops. Help the Product team understand how procurement decisions are made, including technical-commercial evaluations, approval hierarchies, supplier selection, contract obligations, and escalation processes. Review product concepts, prototypes, demos, and new features to validate domain accuracy, workflow completeness, and practical usability. Support product prioritisation by identifying high-impact procurement problems and distinguishing reusable product capabilities from customer-specific requirements. Work with Engineering and other technical teams to clarify functional requirements, business logic, exceptions, and expected outcomes. Help ensure that product capabilities solve genuine procurement problems and fit naturally into existing enterprise workflows. 3. Procurement Systems & Digital Transformation Provide functional knowledge of SAP Ariba, SAP MM/S/4HANA Procurement, Oracle Procurement, Coupa, or comparable ERP and procurement platforms. Explain procurement master data, approval workflows, delegation-of-authority matrices, value thresholds, vendor onboarding, contract records, and audit requirements. Identify gaps in existing ERP and procurement processes where AI agents, automation, and improved user experiences can add value. Help define integration-related business requirements and validate proposed workflows against actual enterprise procurement processes. Support the design of solutions that complement existing procurement systems rather than unnecessarily replacing them. 4. AI Use Case Identification & Workflow Validation Identify practical AI opportunities in tender and bid analysis, technical-commercial comparisons, supplier risk assessment, contract and obligation tracking, BOM/specification review, document processing, procurement recommendations, and post-award monitoring. Assess which activities can be automated, which require AI-assisted recommendations with human approval, and which must remain human-led. Help define approval checkpoints, exception handling, evidence requirements, traceability, and audit trails for AI-assisted procurement decisions. Validate AI-generated outputs against domain knowledge and real-world procurement scenarios, identifying inaccuracies, missing information, and operational risks. Help define measurable business outcomes and acceptance criteria to evaluate the value of AI-enabled procurement workflows. 5. Customer & Stakeholder Collaboration Work with customer-facing teams to understand procurement challenges, gather domain requirements, and support solution discussions and demonstrations. Engage with procurement leaders, project managers, engineering teams, finance stakeholders, and technology teams to validate requirements. Explain complex procurement processes clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Contribute domain expertise to customer workshops, product demonstrations, and solution validation sessions as needed. Required Qualifications & Experience Typically 5–8 years of relevant experience in procurement, project procurement, materials management, supply chain, or commercial operations, with strong EPC exposure. Candidates with deeper domain experience will be preferred where the role requires substantial procurement ownership. Hands-on experience in one or more of the following sectors: shipbuilding/shipyards, aerospace and defence, power plants/energy, heavy engineering, or large infrastructure development. Strong understanding of complex project procurement, including RFQ/tendering, technical and commercial bid evaluation, vendor selection, purchase orders, expediting, contract management, delivery tracking, inspections, and invoice/goods-receipt processes. Experience working with an enterprise procurement platform such as SAP Ariba, SAP MM/S/4HANA, Oracle Procurement, Coupa, or a comparable system. Ability to translate operational challenges into clear workflows, business requirements, business rules, and documented exceptions. Strong stakeholder-management skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, Procurement, Project, Finance, and customer-facing teams. Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain complex domain concepts to product and technology teams. Interest in applying AI and automation to enterprise procurement workflows. Good to Have Experience as a Procurement Lead, Project Procurement Lead, Supply Chain Lead, Materials Lead, Category Lead, or Procurement Transformation Lead. Direct experience handling high-value procurement packages, long-lead equipment, technical-commercial comparative statements, subcontract packages, supplier expediting, inspections, claims, or variation orders. Exposure to digital transformation, ERP implementation, procurement process re-engineering, or enterprise software rollouts. Previous involvement in product management, business analysis, solution consulting, functional consulting, or defining requirements for software products. Familiarity with AI/LLM-enabled workflow automation, document intelligence, supplier analytics, or decision-support tools. Experience with project BOM/BOQ, engineering specifications, quality documentation, and vendor delivery coordination. What Success Looks Like The elsAI Product team gains a reliable domain expert who can explain and validate complex EPC procurement workflows. Real-world procurement challenges are translated into clear, actionable product requirements. AI-enabled procurement features are validated against realistic scenarios, exceptions, and business rules. Product capabilities address meaningful operational challenges while maintaining appropriate human oversight, evidence, and auditability. The gap between customer procurement needs and product capabilities is reduced through continuous domain input and product feedback.

title: Key Account Manager ( Hospital Care )
description:
**Description**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
The Key Account Manager will be responsible for developing and executing account strategies for key corporate hospitals and institutions. The role involves driving business growth through value-based selling, strengthening relationships with key stakeholders, ensuring customer satisfaction, and delivering sales objectives while maintaining compliance with company policies and industry regulations.
  
  
**Essential Functions**

* Develop and execute strategic account plans for assigned key hospitals and corporate accounts.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets within the assigned territory.
* Drive business growth by identifying new hospital opportunities and expanding existing business.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), Key Business Leaders (KBLs), hospital administrators, purchase teams, pharmacists, microbiologists, intensivists, infectious disease specialists, anaesthesiologists, and other stakeholders.
* Understand customer needs, competitor activities, and market dynamics to increase product adoption.
* Develop conversion strategies for new product introductions and institutional business.
* Manage large corporate accounts and monitor account performance to maximize business potential.
* Conduct regular account reviews and implement corrective actions wherever required.
* Build state-wise sales forecasts to achieve budgeted targets.
* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction by addressing customer concerns and improving service delivery.
* Promote Amneal's product differentiators to create strong brand recall.
* Maintain accurate CRM records and update the Must-See List (MSL) regularly.
* Collaborate with Marketing, Medical Affairs, Supply Chain, Commercial Excellence, Finance, and other internal stakeholders to execute business plans effectively.
* Ensure compliance with all company policies and industry regulations while interacting with healthcare professionals and commercial entities.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Analyze account performance and recommend business improvement initiatives.
* Track KPIs and monitor account effectiveness.
* Support Commercial Excellence with sales dashboards, reporting, and execution analytics.
* Monitor competitor activities and market intelligence.
* Participate in sales meetings, training programs, product launches, and developmental initiatives.
* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and an entrepreneurial mindset in delivering business objectives.

**Qualifications**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's Degree in Science (B.Sc., Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or equivalent).
* MBA preferred.
* Strong understanding of institutional selling and hospital business.
* Knowledge of Anti-infective, Critical Care, and Hospital portfolio will be preferred.

**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Science or equivalent.
* MBA (Preferred).

**Experience**

* Minimum 4+ years of successful experience in hospital pharmaceutical sales.
* Proven experience in managing Corporate Hospitals and Institutional Key Accounts.
* Experience in High-End Antibiotics, Anti-infectives, Critical Care, or related specialty portfolio preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in developing strategic customer relationships.
* Experience working in cross-functional environments.
* Strong track record of delivering sales growth and business expansion.

* Key Account Management

* Corporate Hospital Management
* Strategic Selling

* KOL Engagement

title: Salesperson
description:
**Company Description**
Sri Gokulam Hospital is a specialist recruitment agency focused on contingency, search, and contract recruitment across the life sciences sector. The organization has grown both organically and through acquisition, building a team of consultants with over 20 years of industry experience. Capital Pharma supports clients nationwide and globally, placing contract and permanent professionals across Pharma, Medical Affairs, Drug Safety, Clinical, and Biometrics. The company is part of The Jarell Group, which is committed to delivering high-quality workforce solutions and raising industry standards through efficient, compliant processes and services. Candidates joining Capital Pharma can expect to work in a dynamic, growth-oriented environment that values expertise and continuous improvement.
  
**Role Description**
The Salesperson role at Capital Pharma is a full-time, on-site position based in Chennai. In this role, the Salesperson will identify and engage prospective clients within the life sciences sector, present recruitment solutions, and build long-term business relationships. Daily responsibilities include prospecting, conducting client meetings and calls, understanding client hiring needs, and coordinating with internal recruitment teams to deliver suitable candidates. The Salesperson will manage sales pipelines, prepare proposals, negotiate terms, and follow up to ensure client satisfaction and repeat business. This role also involves maintaining accurate records in CRM systems, meeting sales targets, and collaborating with colleagues to support overall business growth.

* Strong sales, business development, and client relationship management skills, ideally within recruitment or life sciences.
* Solid communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at multiple levels.
* Proficiency in basic IT tools and CRM systems, and comfort working with data, reports, and performance metrics.

title: Cargo Account Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Cathay is a premium travel lifestyle brand based in Hong Kong, bringing people closer to the places, experiences and opportunities that matter to them. Our purpose — to move people forward in life — begins with our own people.
  
  
Across our airlines, cargo and lifestyle businesses, it is our people who turn journeys into experiences and ambition into progress. Joining Cathay means being part of a global and inclusive community, driven by thoughtful care, progressive attitude and a can-do spirit — and supported to grow through a meaningful career that moves with you.
  
  
If you are seeking an opportunity to take flight, let your ambitions propel you higher and further. Make Your Career Move, together with Cathay.
  
  
**Role Introduction**
Reports to Regional Cargo Trade Sales Manager – SAMEA
  
  
To achieve and exceed agreed Global and Trade sales targets through the effective use of data, market intelligence, and customer insights. The role is responsible for acquiring new business, strengthening Cathay Cargo’s presence in existing and emerging markets, and proactively managing Global and Trade accounts to deliver sustainable revenue growth. The Account Manager will develop and execute commercial strategies across the assigned ports, drive performance from key accounts and special products, support digital and process improvement initiatives, and provide strong commercial governance while representing Cathay Cargo as the local port commercial lead.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Acquire high-value HBA and SBA business, generate quality sales leads and apply consultative, insight-led selling techniques to identify new commercial opportunities.
* Develop and execute port-level commercial strategies covering incentive structures, yield optimisation, customer agreements and revenue growth across key Global and Trade accounts.
* Grow special-product business across pharmaceuticals, perishables, express, e-commerce, valuables and live animals through clear targets and regular performance reviews.
* Manage customer portfolios, prioritise the highest revenue-generating accounts and conduct business reviews to increase market share, profitability and share of wallet.
* Govern contracts, tariffs, incentives and discount approvals while addressing revenue leakage, discrepancies, escalations and customer disputes in line with company policy.
* Deliver weekly and monthly account plans, conduct monthly sales reviews with Cargo Sales Support Assistant Managers and provide timely revenue updates to the reporting managers.
* Lead port-level adoption of e-booking, digital contracts, customer relationship management systems, reporting dashboards and automation while supporting change management.
* Promote LEAN thinking, continuous process improvement, appropriate use of artificial intelligence tools and cost-saving initiatives.
* Collaborate with Pricing, Customer Relationship Management, Operations, Finance, Regional Commercial, Global Sales and Trade Sales teams to align customer strategies, contracts and execution.
* Drive revenue growth from key Global and Trade accounts by prioritising high-value opportunities and improving the quality and profitability of the customer portfolio.

**Requirements**
**Academic Qualifications**

* University degree or tertiary qualification in business, logistics, supply chain, aviation, commerce, or a related discipline.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Business, Marketing, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field is preferred.
* Additional certification or diploma in logistics, supply chain management, aviation sales, or commercial management is an advantage.

**Knowledge, Skills, Training And Experience**

* 3 – 5 years in Cargo commercial sales.
* Strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and ability to translate market insights into actionable sales plans.
* Proven capability in customer portfolio management, revenue growth, negotiation, and relationship management.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to use data, dashboards, and market intelligence to support decision-making.
* Good understanding of cargo products, airfreight operations, customer segments, revenue management, and competitive market dynamics.
* High level of digital awareness, with a continuous improvement mindset and ability to support adoption of new tools, systems, and processes.
* Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in a matrix, multicultural, and geographically dispersed environment.
* Candidates must have the legal right to live and work in India.

**Benefits**
https://careers.cathaypacific.com/who-we-are/why-work-here
  
  
Cathay is proud to offer eligible employees competitive compensation & benefits package, as varied by location, regularly scheduled hours worked, length of employment and employment status as highlighted below.
  
  

* Travel Privileges on Cathay Pacific Airways Global Network
* Extensive well-being programs including health and employee assistance program benefits to help you stay well.
* Paid Leave
* If this position requires a uniform, a uniform allowance will be provided.

**Personal & Application Information**
Cathay Pacific is an Equal Opportunities Employer. Personal data provided by job applicants will be used strictly in accordance with our personal data policy and for recruitment purposes only.
  
  
All related information will be kept in our file for up to 24 months. A copy of our Personal Information Collection Statement will be provided upon request by contacting our Data Protection Officer.
  
  
We thank all candidates for your interest in Cathay, and regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Candidates not notified within eight weeks may consider their application unsuccessful.
  
  
All job opportunities are published exclusively on our official website. We advise applicants not to apply through or respond to any third-party websites or domains. Kindly exercise caution and avoid unsolicited offers from unofficial sources.

title: Strategic Account Manager - Critical Care (Cochin)
description:
**Role Overview**
The Product Specialist – Critical Care will serve as the primary clinical and commercial interface for Fresenius Medical Care's Critical Care therapy portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of revenue accountability and deep clinical expertise — responsible for driving therapy adoption in ICUs, building institutional relationships, and establishing FME as the therapy partner of choice in the critical care space.
  
  
**Broader Responsibilities**
**Revenue Ownership:**
Accountable for achieving and growing revenue targets within the assigned territory. This includes identifying opportunities for therapy initiation, utilization growth, and account expansion through both new customer acquisition and deepening penetration within existing ICU accounts.
  
  
**ICU Engagement & Therapy Adoption:**
Develop a thorough understanding of ICU workflows, patient profiles, and clinical decision-making dynamics. Engage intensivists, nephrologists, and critical care nursing teams to drive adoption of CRRT/HVHDF therapies and ensure optimal therapy utilization.
  
  
**Account Planning & Coverage:**
Create and execute structured account plans for key hospitals and critical care centres. Conduct regular in-person visits, clinical presentations, and therapy reviews to identify growth opportunities and address adoption barriers proactively.
  
  
**Clinical Support & Demonstration:**
Provide hands-on clinical demonstration, in-service training, and bedside support to healthcare teams on product usage, therapy protocols, and best practices — ensuring both clinical confidence and patient outcome focus.
  
  
**Market Intelligence:**
Track and analyse competitive activity, therapy trends, and account-level data to continuously refine territory strategy and share actionable insights with the marketing and clinical teams.
  
  
**KOL Development:**
Identify, engage, and develop Key Opinion Leaders within the critical care and nephrology community to advocate for therapy upgradation, support peer education, and strengthen FME's clinical credibility in the market.
  
  
**Key Deliverables**

* Quarterly and annual revenue targets for the Critical Care portfolio
* Therapy initiation and utilization metrics across assigned accounts
* Number of active ICU accounts under structured engagement
* Clinical training and in-service sessions conducted
* KOL engagement pipeline — identified, engaged, and activated
* Timely and accurate reporting of account activity, pipeline, and market intelligence

**Expectations**
**Cross-functional Collaboration:**
Work closely with the Sales, Technical Service, Marketing, and Clinical teams to ensure seamless pre- and post-sale support. Act as the critical care voice within the commercial team.
  
  
**Solution-oriented Mindset:**
Understand the specific clinical and operational challenges of each ICU and offer tailored therapy solutions — backed by clinical evidence, product knowledge, and a genuine understanding of patient care outcomes.
  
  
**Commercial Acumen with Clinical Credibility:**
Balance revenue orientation with the ability to engage credibly in clinical conversations. The role demands someone who can speak the language of the ICU and the boardroom with equal fluency.
  
  
**Ideal Profile**

* Graduate in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, or Biomedical Engineering; paramedical background in critical care is a strong advantage
* 3–6 years of experience in medical devices, with at least 2 years in ICU-facing roles (CRRT, ventilation, hemodynamic monitoring, or similar)
* Demonstrated ability to drive revenue growth in a clinical selling environment
* Strong communication, relationship-building, and clinical presentation skills
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory

description:

Head - Operations

Full-time

1. Role Purpose

To develop and strengthen AIC–CIIC’s startup incubation ecosystem and drive industry engagement, outreach, and utilization of its Smart and Clean Mobility laboratories. The position will be responsible for identifying and engaging startups, connecting them with technical and business support, promoting laboratory services to industry and academia, and building partnerships that generate measurable incubation outcomes and sustainable lab utilization.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Startup Incubation & Programme Management**

* Identify, source, and engage prospective startups in smart mobility, electric mobility, renewable energy, battery technologies, automotive electronics, green chemistry, recycling, and allied deep-tech sectors.
* Coordinate startup applications, screening, evaluation, onboarding, incubation agreements, and milestone tracking.
* Support the implementation of incubation, pre-incubation, accelerator, and entrepreneurship development programmes.
* Coordinate startup mentoring, investor interactions, industry connects, workshops, demo days, and networking sessions.
* Track startup progress, including technology development, prototype readiness, pilots, revenue, funding, jobs created, and graduation.
* Maintain startup databases, incubation records, programme calendars, reports, and impact metrics.

**B. Smart and Clean Mobility Labs Outreach**

* Promote AIC–CIIC laboratory capabilities to automotive OEMs, Tier-1/Tier-2 suppliers, EV manufacturers, component developers, engineering service companies, research institutions, and startups.
* Develop business leads for laboratory services, technical validation, prototyping, simulation, testing, and engineering support.
* Coordinate outreach for available facilities, including Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), battery testing and validation, EMI/EMC, chassis dynamometer, simulation, and other approved lab services.
* Understand customer requirements and coordinate with technical teams to prepare suitable service proposals, quotations, and project scopes.
* Follow up on leads, coordinate lab visits and technical discussions, and support conversion of enquiries into approved service engagements.
* Maintain a laboratory outreach pipeline, service enquiries, utilization records, customer feedback, and revenue-generation reports.
* Coordinate with technical personnel to ensure customer requirements are aligned with available equipment, capacity, safety procedures, and technical capabilities.

**C. Industry Partnerships & Ecosystem Development**

* Build relationships with automotive and mobility OEMs, component manufacturers, EV startups, technology providers, industry associations, academic institutions, and government-supported innovation programmes.
* Identify opportunities for MoUs, joint workshops, sponsored programmes, industry challenges, pilot projects, and collaborative R&D.
* Coordinate with industry partners to identify technical problems that can be addressed by AIC–CIIC incubatees and laboratory facilities.
* Facilitate connections between startups and potential customers, mentors, technical experts, investors, and strategic partners.
* Support industry visits, delegation meetings, partnership proposals, and follow-up actions.

**D. Programme Outreach & Communications**

* Plan and execute startup outreach campaigns, industry engagement programmes, technical workshops, hackathons, accelerator activities, and demo days.
* Prepare presentations, outreach emails, brochures, service catalogues, event reports, and programme updates.
* Coordinate with the communications team for website updates, LinkedIn posts, startup showcases, and announcements.
* Represent AIC–CIIC at relevant industry events, startup forums, academic institutions, and networking programmes.

**E. Reporting & Administration**

* Maintain an updated CRM or structured database of startups, prospects, partners, mentors, and lab-service customers.
* Prepare monthly reports on startup pipeline, incubation progress, outreach activities, lab enquiries, conversions, utilization, and partnerships.
* Track follow-up commitments, programme budgets, service proposals, and deliverables.
* Ensure documentation and reporting comply with AIC–CIIC policies, funding-agency requirements, and management directions.

3. Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Business Administration, Entrepreneurship, or a related discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification in management, innovation, technology commercialization, or a related field is desirable.
* Approximately 2–5 years of experience in startup incubation, business development, industry relations, technical sales, laboratory services, or innovation programmes.
* Experience in the automotive, EV, clean energy, electronics, battery, or deep-tech ecosystem is preferred.
* Strong communication, presentation, relationship management, coordination, and reporting skills.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, presentations, CRM tools, and basic project management.

**Company Description**
Promantu INC is a technology services company specializing in enterprise solutions and SAP implementations for clients across diverse industries. **Role Description**
The SAP Presales Expert role at Promantu INC is a full-time, hybrid position based in Chennai, with flexibility for partial work from home. In this role, the individual will collaborate with sales teams to understand client needs, design appropriate SAP solutions, and prepare compelling proposals and presentations. Day-to-day activities include analyzing business processes, demonstrating SAP capabilities, creating solution architectures, and supporting RFP and RFI responses. The SAP Presales Expert will engage with prospective clients, conduct product demos, address technical and functional queries, and coordinate with delivery teams to ensure solution feasibility and alignment. The role also involves staying current with SAP product updates, industry trends, and best practices to provide informed recommendations and drive successful presales engagements.
  
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The SAP MDG Pre-Sales Consultant / Solution Architect acts as the bridge between prospective enterprise clients, the sales/account team, and delivery/technical delivery teams. They translate complex business data governance challenges into compelling SAP MDG and S/4HANA solutions.
  
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
• Opportunity Qualification & Discovery: Lead discovery sessions with client stakeholders (CIOs, Data Owners, Business Process Leads) to uncover pain points in master data quality, governance, and lifecycle management.
  
• Solution Architecture & Design: Formulate high-level SAP MDG target architectures (covering Central Governance, Consolidation, Mass Processing, and Data Quality Management for domains like Material, Customer, Supplier, and Finance).
  
• Demos & Proof of Concepts (PoCs): Plan, build, and deliver tailored software demonstrations, scoping workshops, and PoCs to showcase SAP MDG capabilities.
  
• RFP/RFI & Proposal Management: Lead the technical and functional response to Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Requests for Information (RFIs), including effort estimation, commercial scoping, and resource planning.
  
• Risk Assessment & Estimation: Identify delivery risks early in the sales cycle and collaborate with delivery/offshore centers to align proposed timelines, budgets, and milestones.
  
• Sales Enablement & Handoff: Educate account teams on SAP data products and ensure a smooth transition of won projects from sales to the delivery/implementation teams.
  
  
  
Required Qualifications & Skills
  
  
• Experience: Typically 10 to 15+ years of total SAP experience, with hands-on or architectural background in SAP MDG and prior pre-sales/solutioning exposure.
  
• Functional & Technical Depth:
  
• Deep understanding of SAP MDG (Central Governance, Consolidation, Mass Processing, Workflow design, Data Quality Management).
  
• Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform), and broader enterprise data migration/governance tools.
  
• Knowledge of core/advanced ABAP concepts related to MDG workflow and UI configurations is a strong plus

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC302349
description:
**Description**
**About the Role & Team**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI-led engineering through hands-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  
  
This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket-bound Scrum cycles toward intent-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production-ready software.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience**
**Must-Have Attributes**
– Experience: 12+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product-side delivery.
  
  
– SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
  
  
– Hands-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
  
  
– Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
  
  
– Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
– Customer-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high-touch, customer-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre-Sales Engineering Leader).
  
  
– AI Governance & Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human-in-the-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI-enabled enterprise systems.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Client Engagement & Strategic Architecture

– Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high-value areas for AI-led acceleration.
  
  
– Design & Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
  
  
– Lead the Intent-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
  
  
  

* Value Measurement & Executive Alignment

– Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story-to-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
  
  
– Technical & Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C-level stakeholders.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Customer Experience Splunk Technical Leader
description:
**Meet the Team**
As a Customer Success Technical Leader, you are passionate about customers and will fuel solutions to ensure every customer request makes the deepest impact possible for our customers and share the best-of-the-best with the team. You will be a Splunk expert and adept at understanding, adapting, and guiding our account teams and customers on how to best use our Platform.
  
  
**Your impact**
**Responsibilities**

* Skilled and aligned to Splunk Security license products, such as Enterprise Security (ES), security applications like Splunk User Behavior Analytics (UBA), and/or SOAR (Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response)
* Highly skilled and aligned to Splunk’s Core licensed product, such as Enterprise and Cloud.
* Strategically support the Customer Success Executive, Technical Success Engineer, Solution Engineer, Solution Architect motions.
* Develop strong partnership with Sales/Customer Success roles to assist Area aligned customers with Value Realization. Activities include, but not limited to:

+ Onboarding & Enablement – deliver workshops, prescriptive guidance/assistance, achieve onboarding milestones
+ Health Review & Remediation
+ Security Use Case Activation
+ Proactively engaging Technical Success Engineers to review and assess their account’s health situation, with an emphasis on accounts that have telemetry risk signals and/or 6 months from renewal date.
+ Proactively engaging Customer Success Executives on adoption/use case-related work opportunity.
+ Proactively engage CS/SE Management to ensure priority focus alignment and address risk accounts themes.
+ Strategic case-based delivery, up to 90 days of assistance, which is requested by internal Area aligned account teams or management. This typically involves providing customers with high-quality technical advice on Enterprise level architecture, implementation, configuration and optimization work in complex environments for Splunk Enterprise Security, UBA/UEBA, and/or SOAR.

**As a Customer Success Technical Leader, you will**

* Be passionate about customers and deliver impactful solutions.
* Address organizations’ complex technical challenges, proactively identifying and resolving issues before they impact the customer.
* Be a self-motivated Splunk expert eager to learn and adapt in a multifaceted environment.
* Guide account team members and customers on optimal use of Splunk Platform and Splunk Enterprise Security. Provide recommendations for a customer’s overall technical health.
* Deliver strategic, case-based technical consulting (up to 90 days).
* Collaborate with internal resources and customer-facing teams to manage customer needs.
* Conduct research from various resources with the ability to consistently find answers to questions and solve complex technical problems.
* Execute consultative conversations with decision makers to diagnose and establish the potential value of solving business issues, change or expand existing solution requirements based on your discovery/assessment, and provide broader based recommendations to help customers accelerate their product initiatives, optimize cost, and maximize performance.
* Gain agreement with account team members and customer decision-makers on the tangible value of proposed solutions.
* Deliver customer onboarding enablement-based workshops and achieve success milestones.
* Contribute to practice KPIs through process and collateral improvements, tool development, and implementation.

**Minimum Qualifications-**

* Deep technical knowledge of Splunk Enterprise Security (ES) configuration, administration, and development, including expertise in Assets and Identities, Threat Intelligence, Notable Events, Adaptive Response, and Risk-based Analytics.
* Data Management: Experience with integrating and normalising data from diverse sources. Understanding of the Common Information Model (CIM) and experience with data onboarding, including forwarding architecture and technical add-ons.
* Strong command of Search Processing Language (SPL); experience developing and optimizing correlation and risk-based alerting rules.
* Strong Splunk architecture, data onboarding, and Splunk Core product feature experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Cybersecurity Domain: Solid foundation in security operations, forensics, threat hunting, insider threats, and compliance.
* Cybersecurity Frameworks: Solid foundation in NIST CSF, CIS, HIPAA, PCI DSS
* Industry Standard Security Certifications: GIAC, CISSP, OSCP or equivalent
* Infrastructure: Understanding of enterprise architecture across on-premise and Cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Splunk Certifications/Accreditations: ES Implementation Accreditation and/or SOAR consultant I & II
* Understanding of enterprise architecture across on-premise and Cloud environments
* Statistical and analytical modeling skills are a plus.
* Proficiency with scripting languages (bash), application development (Java, Python, .NET), databases, and analytical tools.
* Hands-on experience with Splunk product implementation of focus and Splunk Cloud.
* Experience with cloud migration projects.
* Solid experience in technical consulting or big-data analytics.

**Soft Skills-**

* Trusted technical advisor with the ability to lead assigned tickets and priorities. Engages in “out of the box” thinking to resolve problems
* Relationship Management - Establish technical credibility with a wide range of internal and customer contacts with the ability to “read” the internal/customer contact and adapt behavior / approach
* Conflict Resolution - Ability to engage in escalation management
* Influencing/Negotiating - Ability to influence peers, Splunk leadership and customers. Ability to handle highly complex/distributed IT environments and/or accounts that demand a high level of negotiation and conflict resolution abilities
* Problem/Need Identification - Demonstrates a deep comprehension of the customers, account team and/or customer’s business strategy, business objectives & challenges, success criteria/how customer measures success, and training needs. Analyzes trends to predict changes that may impact customer’s long-term business goals
* Mentor/Team Player - Possesses ability to take on mentorship roles as identified by management team. Identifies, defines, and leads Priorities to Improve to help team reach its goals
* Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills. Active listening and objective consideration of others’ opinions.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Forward Deployed Engineer at DevRev, you will work closely with our pre- and post-sales Customer Experience team by developing solutions over the core platform via applications written in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, etc. One of the key functions of this role is, building the Knowledge Graph that includes integration of DevRev with other SaaS and non-SaaS systems through webhooks and APIs and/ or real-time communication architectures. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers' processes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Customer-facing: 30% working directly with customers.
* Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation
* Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers' existing tech stacks and workflows.
* Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow.
* Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience.
* Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making.
* Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback.
* Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment.
* Guide Technical Adoption: Learn and master new tools, then guide customers through critical workflows like code repository integrations and advanced configurations.
* Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 30% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements.

**What You Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus.
* Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Coding Skills: Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, data structures and algorithms. (Nice to have: Go)
* Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions.
* Integration Expertise: Deep experience with large-scale data synchronization (one-way and two-way), API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks), and event-driven/pub/sub architectures.
* Cloud & Deployment: Hands-on experience deploying on serverless and edge platforms (AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Functions) with modern DevOps practices (CI/CD, containers, observability).
* Data Transformation: Skilled in data mapping, schema alignment, and working with heterogeneous systems. Understanding of data modeling and graph data structures.
* Observability: Experience implementing clear logging, actionable error surfacing, and telemetry to support faster debugging and issue resolution.
* Context-Aware Systems: Familiarity with Model Context Programming (MCP) for building adaptive, context-aware integrations.
* Problem-Solving: Strong track record triaging and unblocking both technical and non-technical blockers to keep projects moving forward.
* Documentation: Experience writing concise, well-structured documentation that supports long-term team understanding and seamless onboarding.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal skills to articulate technical concepts to engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders.

As part of our hiring process, shortlisted candidates will undergo a Background Verification (BGV). By applying, you consent to sharing personal information required for this process. Any offer made will be subject to successful completion of the BGV.
  
  
**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!

The
