We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: Consulting Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
Consulting Manager role for a global organization focusing on property and casualty insurance clients responsible for driving complex consulting engagements optimizing business processes and enhancing operational efficiency in a hybrid work model. The role demands eight to ten years of relevant experience and deep domain expertise to deliver measurable outcomes for insurers.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead end to end consulting engagements for property and casualty insurance clients by defining problem statements structuring approach and ensuring delivery of measurable business outcomes that strengthen client competitiveness and operational resilience.
* Oversee analysis of underwriting policy administration billing and claims processes to identify efficiency gaps control weaknesses and transformation opportunities that improve loss ratios service quality and regulatory compliance.
* Provide expert guidance on property and casualty insurance products rating methodologies and risk selection practices to help clients refine portfolio strategies and enhance sustainable profitability.
* Drive development of detailed business requirements user stories and process maps for core insurance platforms and surrounding applications to support system enhancements and digital transformation initiatives.
* Coordinate with client stakeholders across business operations technology and compliance functions to align consulting recommendations with strategic priorities and practical implementation constraints.
* Develop clear and compelling presentations reports and business cases that translate complex analysis and insurance concepts into actionable insights for executives and operational leaders.
* Collaborate with technology teams to support design and validation of solutions such as workflow automation data analytics models and self service capabilities that streamline property and casualty insurance operations.
* Monitor engagement progress through well defined milestones risks and dependencies while recommending corrective actions to maintain scope quality and timelines in a hybrid work environment.
* Guide change management activities by proposing communication plans training approaches and adoption metrics that help client teams embrace new processes and systems without disruption to daily service delivery.
* Evaluate key performance indicators across claims handling customer service and policy servicing to recommend continuous improvement initiatives that enhance client satisfaction and reduce operating costs.
* Support sales and account teams by contributing domain expertise solution concepts and effort estimates for proposals targeting property and casualty insurance organizations.
* Ensure that all consulting deliverables reflect current regulatory expectations market trends and emerging risks in property and casualty insurance so clients can make informed strategic decisions.
* Document lessons learned reusable frameworks and best practices from each engagement to strengthen organizational knowledge capital and improve future project effectiveness.

**Qualifications**

* Bring eight to ten years of experience in consulting or business analysis roles with a strong focus on property and casualty insurance operations and transformation programs.
* Demonstrate in depth understanding of underwriting workflows policy lifecycle management claims adjudication and associated controls within property and casualty insurance.
* Exhibit proficiency in process analysis requirements gathering and stakeholder management to translate client needs into practical and clearly defined consulting deliverables.
* Apply solid analytical and problem solving skills using data driven approaches to evaluate performance metrics and recommend realistic improvement options for insurance clients.
* Show familiarity with core insurance platforms and related tools used in property and casualty carriers to effectively support system enhancement and modernization initiatives.
* Display strong communication and presentation capabilities to engage diverse stakeholders and explain complex property and casualty topics in accessible business language.
* Maintain adaptability to work in a hybrid model with effective time management and collaboration skills that support cross functional project teams across locations.

Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**

* Strong capability in PMU support, including project tracking, milestone management, and preparation of governance and progress reports. Demonstrated experience in strategy development and translating analytical findings into actionable infrastructure advisory recommendations. Proficient in IP and trade analytics, with the ability to assess market, policy, and regulatory trends impacting advisory engagements. Skilled in conducting structured research, data analysis, and synthesis of findings to support client decision-making. Ability to contribute to infrastructure advisory projects through robust consulting analysis, documentation, and presentation of insights.

**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**

* Master of Business Administration

**Experience**

* Project Management (6+ years)

**What We Look For**
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. At EY, you will have a personalized Career Journey and also the chance to tap into the resources of our career frameworks to better know about your roles, skills, and opportunities.
  
  
EY is equally committed to being an inclusive employer, and we strive to achieve the right balance for our people—enabling us to deliver excellent client service while allowing our people to build their careers as well as focus on their wellbeing.
  
  
If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.
  
  
Join us in shaping the future with confidence. Apply Now

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC300053
description:
**Description**
**Department/Project Description**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Product Architect to work at the intersection of core product engineering, AI orchestration, and high-impact client deployment. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).
  
  
You are not just deploying a tool; you are embedding autonomous, intent-driven AI workflows into the client’s product ecosystem. This role requires a hands-on builder, deep product architect, and first-principles thinker who can gain trust with client developers and justify product ROI to executive stakeholders.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Job Responsibilities**
**Domain-Specific AI Integration**
Architect Intent-Driven Workflows: Design and deploy agentic AI workflows tailored to complex financial domain logic, ensuring systems can reliably process high-stakes data (e.g., automated credit underwriting analysis, regulatory compliance checking, or algorithmic fraud intent mapping).
  
  
Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.
  
  
Bridge Legacy Core Systems: Design secure abstraction layers and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations that allow AI systems to interact seamlessly with legacy core-banking systems, monolithic financial ledgers, and rigid enterprise APIs.
  
  
**Product Delivery & SDLC Acceleration**
Accelerate Product Feature Delivery: Partner directly with the client’s product and engineering leadership to replace traditional, bottlenecked sprint cycles with autonomous delivery loops that generate domain-compliant code, comprehensive unit tests, and validation artifacts.
  
  
Establish Guardrails & AI Governance: Implement deterministic controls, “human-in-the-loop” verification, and automated compliance checks within the AI pipeline to meet strict financial sector regulatory standards (e.g., SEC, GDPR, SOC2).
  
  
Measure Engineering Velocity: Define, track, and report on hard product metrics resulting from AI implementation, such as reduction in feature-to-production cycle time, code review velocity, and coverage of automated edge-case test generation.
  
  
**Forward-Deployed Customer Engagement**
Embedded Engineering Leadership: Embed directly within client engineering teams as a trusted technical advisor, leading by example by writing code, evaluating architectures, and building working proofs of concept.
  
  
Translate Intent to Architecture: Map high-level business goals from client Product Managers into technical AI specifications, ensuring the AI agents accurately understand product requirements and domain constraints.
  
  
Executive Value Articulation: Present technical architectures, security postures, and measured business outcomes to both engineering teams and C-level executives (CTO, Chief Risk Officer, CPO).
  
  
Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Must-Have Qualifications And Experience**
Experience: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise product architecture, platform engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 5+ years spent delivering high-scale products within the Financial Services or Enterprise SaaS sectors.
  
  
Technical Fluency: Deep, hands-on fluency with the modern AI stack. You must be able to build, evaluate, and debug AI development tools, agentic frameworks, and IDE-based assistants.
  
  
Domain Expertise: Thorough understanding of financial technology standards, secure SDLC, DevSecOps, data privacy laws, and enterprise architecture patterns.
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
Direct experience with tools/frameworks like Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, and vector databases.
  
  
Background in customer-facing technical roles such as Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, or Technical Advisor.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

Microsoft Security Solutions

title: Cyber- DT&P-Strategy & Architecture - AI Security Senior Consultant
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
AI Security Consultant, Strategy and Architecture
  
  
As a Senior Consultant in our AI Cyber Strategy & Architecture practice, you will take a leading role in designing and delivering enterprise-grade AI security frameworks, reference architectures, and AI governance programs for our clients. You will work with independence and technical authority, driving the execution of complex engagements while mentoring junior team members and beginning to shape client relationships. This role sits at the intersection of AI innovation and cybersecurity risk - translating sophisticated threat landscapes into actionable, business-aligned security strategies.
  
  
You will be expected to bring a depth of expertise across AI security architecture, threat modeling, and compliance alignment, while demonstrating the ability to lead workstreams end-to-end with minimal supervision.
  
  
Work you'll do
  
  
As an AI Cyber Strategy and Architecture Senior Consultant, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Lead discovery sessions to translate regulatory and framework requirements - including NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act and ISO 42001- into practical, implementable security controls across AI platforms and data pipelines.
* Assess clients’ AI cybersecurity posture against their business environment, objectives, and risk appetite; identify key strengths and gaps, and develop prioritized recommendations aligned to their constraints and priorities.
* Evaluate AI-specific risks through structured risk assessments and threat modeling, including prompt injection, data leakage, model supply chain compromise, and agentic privilege escalation scenarios.
* Translate assessment findings into enterprise AI security roadmaps by mapping current-state capabilities to target-state architectures, defining required controls, and documenting sequenced remediation actions.
* Contribute to the development, review, and updating of cybersecurity policies, standards, and procedures to incorporate AI-specific risks and controls.
* Contribute to the development of AI security reference architectures covering LLM deployment patterns, RAG pipelines, vector databases, agentic workflows, and model-serving architecture.
* Develop impactful reports and presentations that support the achievement of engagement goals and objectives.
* Collaborate with client engineering, security operations, and business stakeholders to validate architecture decisions and ensure alignment with enterprise security standards.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  
  

* Takes ownership of assigned workstreams and deliverables, managing time and quality with minimal oversight while keeping senior colleagues informed of progress and blockers.
* Communicates complex technical architecture and risk concepts clearly in written and verbal formats, adapting the level of detail for engineering teams and business stakeholders alike.
* Approaches unfamiliar AI platforms, frameworks, and threat vectors with structured curiosity - decomposing problems, researching quickly, and applying findings to real client contexts.
* Demonstrates a delivery-first mindset, consistently producing high-quality work products on schedule and proactively flagging risks to project timelines.
* Collaborates effectively across multidisciplinary teams spanning AI engineering, cloud security, identity, data, and risk management.

The team
  
  
Deloitte Cyber for AI practice helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security and operations.
  
  
We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle, so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data or infrastructure risk.
  
  
Within the practice, the Identity capability focuses on how agents, workloads and people are identified, authenticated, authorized and governed across enterprise and cloud environments.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field; alternatively, equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 4+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with demonstrated exposure to technology strategy engagements, risk assessments and security architecture .
* Familiarity with established cybersecurity and AI governance frameworks such as NIST CSF, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001 or the EU AI Act.
* Experience conducting or contributing to threat modeling, architecture risk assessments, or security gap analyses against defined control frameworks.
* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), including an understanding of native security services, shared responsibility models, and cloud-native architecture patterns.
* Foundational understanding of AI and machine learning concepts, including how LLMs, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and agentic systems function, and the security risks they introduce.
* Ability to produce clear, structured technical documentation - including architecture diagrams, control mapping matrices, risk registers, and strategy decks - suitable for both engineering and executive audiences.
* Ability to travel 25% to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and engagements you serve.

Preferred:
  
  

* Previous consulting, client delivery or customer-facing engineering experience.
* Experience across both managed AI services, self-hosted and other AI platforms.
* Excellent communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills.
* Hands-on experience developing AI cyber security assessments, AI threat modelling and AI policies and standards development.
* Experience with AI frameworks and regulations including NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act and ISO 42001.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CRISC etc .

description:

This role focuses on building strong, trusted relationships and positioning Emerson’s Measurement Solutions portfolio within engineering standards, specifications, and project requirements before procurement begins. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

title: Chief Architect-GRC
description:

 The WorkNEXT AI Tech Expert is the technical ambassador for WorkNEXT AI modules—owning end\-to\-end client engagement, discovery, solution design, demos, pilots, and technical enablement. This role translates business pain points into pragmatic AI solutions, drives adoption and outcomes, and partners with product, engineering, and customer success to ensure WorkNEXT deployments deliver measurable value at scale.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Client Engagement \& Solutioning**
* Lead technical conversations with enterprise clients: discovery, requirements analysis, solution architecture, and value mapping.
* Conduct tailored demos and hands\-on workshops for WorkNEXT AI modules (e.g., workflows, assistants, analytics, automation).
* Design proof\-of\-concepts (POCs) and pilot plans, including success criteria, data readiness, and deployment approach.
* Translate business needs into AI\-driven use cases and solution designs (incl. integrations, data pipelines, governance).


**Technical Ownership**
* Build reference architectures and implementation playbooks for WorkNEXT AI modules across common enterprise stacks.
* Partner with engineering to scope features, validate feasibility, and drive technical issue resolution.
* Configure and optimize WorkNEXT AI models and workflows (prompt strategies, orchestration, guardrails, evaluation).
* Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and responsible AI standards; coordinate with InfoSec and legal teams.


**Customer Success \& Enablement**
* Create client\-facing technical collateral: solution briefs, runbooks, FAQs, architecture diagrams, ROI calculators.
* Train client admins and super\-users; develop enablement plans and adoption campaigns.
* Monitor post\-deployment health: performance metrics, drift, model evaluation, user feedback loops.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Capture client feedback and market signals to inform product roadmap and prioritization.
* Collaborate with Sales/Pre\-Sales for deal strategy, estimates, and RFP responses.
* Work with Data Engineering and Integration teams to ensure robust pipelines and API/connector reliability.


**Required Skills \& Competencies**
**Technical**
* Strong understanding of AI/ML foundations: NLP, LLMs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, model evaluation.
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure/AWS/GCP), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and API integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, webhooks).
* Knowledge of data pipelines (ETL/ELT), vector databases/embeddings, and observability of AI systems.
* Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and responsible AI (RBAC, PII handling, auditability, human\-in\-the\-loop).
* Ability to create architecture diagrams, deployment runbooks, and performance monitoring strategies.


**Client\-Facing**
* Exceptional communication—can simplify complex AI concepts for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Consultative approach—discovery, problem framing, value story, and objection handling.
* Strong demo presence; comfortable tailoring demos to industry verticals and role personas.
* Negotiation and stakeholder management across business, IT, InfoSec, and procurement.


**Mindset**
* Outcome\-oriented: focuses on measurable business impact, not just features.
* Curious and experimental: rapid prototyping, A/B testing, iterative improvement.
* Ownership and accountability: proactive risk management, transparent communication.


**Qualifications**
* 6–10\+ years in Client\-Facing Technical roles (e.g., Solutions Architect, Pre\-Sales Engineer, AI Consultant).
* 3\+ years hands\-on with AI/ML, LLM applications, or automation platforms.
* Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in at least one enterprise vertical (e.g., BFSI, Manufacturing, Retail, Healthcare) is a plus.
* Certifications in cloud/AI (Azure AI Engineer, AWS ML Specialty, GCP ML Engineer) preferred.


**Typical WorkNEXT AI Use\-Case Areas (Adjust to your modules)**
* Knowledge assistant with RAG for policy/SOP retrieval, multilingual Q\&A.
* Process automation: ticket triage, claim summarization, email drafting, task routing.
* Insight generation: summarization of meetings/chats, trend analysis, risk alerts.
* Employee experience: HR policy assistant, IT helpdesk copilot, onboarding flows.
* Compliance \& governance: redaction, PII detection, audit\-ready conversation logs.

title: Provider Management Specialist
description:
**About Amplify Health**




**Who We Are** 




 Amplify Health is Asia’s leading health technology and analytics organisation, providing our customers with integrated solutions to make healthcare more accessible, affordable and effective across the region.
 



  





 We offer a unique B2B business model and integrated stack of SaaS\-based products, PaaS\-based HealthTech launchpad and DaaS\-based on\-demand data offerings to deliver impact to our customers across the healthcare value\-chain.
 



  





 Our joint\-venture partners, AIA and Discovery, have provided us with the foundations and a platform that truly differentiates us from our competitors and allows us to build and deploy products at a scale and quality that few can match.
 



  





 We aim to be the trusted custodian of Asia's largest repository of health data, unifying financial, clinical, operational and behavioural data to empower our customers with insights that highlight opportunities to deliver better value and care outcomes.
 



  





**Our Vision and Ambition** 




 To build the leading healthcare AI and platform services company in Asia that transforms the delivery of health and wellness for patients and communities by combining and leveraging the distinctive and complementary assets and strengths of AIA and Discovery.
 



 Amplify Health will simplify access to health data and AI Innovation to accelerate distinct and disruptive healthcare value insights and resulting improvements in health outcomes through value\-based care, personalised care plans and aligning individuals’ lifestyle/ behavioural choices.
 



 By 2028, Amplify Health will have in place one of Asia’s strongest health\-tech and AI capabilities; a comprehensive, integrated health technology stack supported by precision insights derived from proprietary data pools.
 



  





**The Position**




**Summary** 




 As a Provider Management Specialist, the role is a specialist advisor position supporting private health insurers to improve their claims risk management, primarily through provider contracting strategy, panel optimisation, patient pathway design, and insurance product alignment.
 



 You will work directly with client teams, enabling them to build stronger provider networks, negotiate effectively, utilise data insights, and apply best‑practice provider management strategies within the healthcare and HealthTech ecosystem.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**1\) On‑Site Client Advisory \& Provider Management Support** 



* Serves as the primary advisor to senior insurer stakeholders to drive and support provider management targets, initiatives and implementations, including, supporting strategic initiatives, contracting cycles, and provider engagement plans.
* Shapes multi‑year provider strategy, including contracting redesign and ecosystem partnerships.
* Develop high‑quality materials for client prep sessions, executive updates, and provider negotiations, ensuring clarity, coherence and insight‑driven storytelling.
* Serve as an embedded advisor supporting the client’s operational and strategic objectives.



**2\) Internal Provider Analytics Product Development** 



* Translate key client needs, pain points, and market insights into product requirements.
* Provide structured feedback to evolve Amplify Health’s provider analytics tools, dashboards and negotiation support solutions.
* Acts as the thought partner to product leadership for long‑term roadmap development.



**3\) Capability Building and Upskilling Client Teams** 



* Identify and prioritize key knowledge gaps and design tailored workshops, demos and training modules to upskill capabilities across client teams.
* Run coaching and role‑play sessions to elevate client teams’ provider negotiation capabilities and commercial acumen to improve negotiations for provider engagements.



  





**Candidate Profile**




**Experience and Qualifications** 



* Over 6 years experience in health insurance, health\-related industries or consulting.
* Demonstrated success in managing cost efficiencies in healthcare, whether at providers, insurers or population health level.
* Proven experience in client advisory work particularly in healthcare related work.
* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA or relevant) strongly preferred.



  





**Competencies \& Core Characteristics:** 




 We are seeking a leader who embodies the following competencies and characteristics essential for success in our scale\-up environment:
 


* **Strategic Architect:** 
 Able to connect disparate information into a cohesive strategy leveraging Amplify Health frameworks. Capable of designing clear, actionable paths for clients navigating complex provider ecosystems.
* **Data\-Driven Decisiveness:** 
 Confidence in working with data, identifying insights, and translating analytics into compelling narratives. Ensures objective, evidence‑based decision‑making in provider negotiations and strategy formulation.
* **Customer‑Obsessed Advocate:** 
 Anticipates client needs and proactively delivers value through insights, structure and advisory support.
* **Resilient Operator:** 
 able to operate in a fluid and changing start\-up environment, flexing between internal work and client facing modes
* **Unifier \& Cross\-Functional Influencer:** 
 Collaborates seamlessly across clinical, analytics, commercial and product teams. Drives alignment and shared understanding between stakeholders.

title: Manager Revenue Operations
description:
**Who are we?** 




 Securin is an AI\-driven cybersecurity company focused on proactive, adversarial exposure and vulnerability management. Our mission is to help organizations reduce cyber risk by identifying, prioritising, and remediating the issues that matter most. Powered by a seasoned team of threat researchers and status as a Certified Naming Authority (CNA), Securin combines artificial intelligence / machine learning, threat intelligence, and deep vulnerability research (including the Dark Web) to deliver an adversarial approach to cyber defence. We help enterprises shift from reactive patching to strategic, risk\-based exposure and vulnerability management – driving smarter security decisions and faster remediation.
 



  





**What do we promise?** 




 We are a highly effective tech\-enabled cybersecurity solutions provider and promise continual security posture improvement, enhanced attack surface visibility, and proactive prioritized remediation for every one of our client businesses.
 



  





**What do we provide?** 



* A chance to be on the leading edge of cybersecurity and AI
* Ability to have direct impact on company growth and revenue strategy
* An opportunity to mentor and be mentored by experts in multiple disciplines



  





**What do we deliver?** 




 Securin helps organizations to identify and remediate the most dangerous exposures, vulnerabilities, and risks in their environment. We deliver predictive and definitive intelligence and facilitate proactive remediation to help organizations stay a step ahead of attackers.
 



  





 By utilizing our cybersecurity solutions, our clients can have a proactive and holistic view of their security posture and protect their assets from even the most advanced and dynamic attacks.
 



 Securin has been recognized by national and international organizations for its role in accelerating innovation in offensive and proactive security. Our combination of domain expertise, cutting\-edge technology, and advanced tech\-enabled cybersecurity solutions has made Securin a leader in the industry.
 



  





**Job Location :** 
 Chennai (Hybrid Model : 2\-3 days a week to office)
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This is a hands\-on IC role: you'll own CRM hygiene, reporting, forecasting, and process enforcement. The core GTM systems and processes are already in place. Your role is to drive adoption, improve execution, and identify where those systems need refinement — not undertake a wholesale rebuild.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Drive adoption of existing CRM and revenue processes across sales, marketing, and CS — find where reps skip steps, and fix it
* Drive team\-wide MEDDIC adoption; coach reps; report on qualification data quality
* Own revenue reporting — Pipeline visibility, funnel conversion by stage, forecast accuracy
* Own forecasting cadence and accuracy in partnership with sales leadership
* Continuously refine the sales process using data — stall points, broken handoffs, adoption gaps
* Align sales, marketing, and CS on shared process and data usage
* Maintain CRM data quality — clear ownership of required fields, stage progression, activity capture, and opportunity hygiene
* Own CRM/system change requests, incorporating input from sales leadership and consultants, and drive them through to adoption
* Use GenAI tools to accelerate reporting, analysis, and documentation — validate outputs before they inform decisions



  





**Requirements:** 



* 5\+ years of relevant experience in B2B SaaS set up \- in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Operations, CRM Operations, or a related revenue\-facing operations role, in B2B SaaS
* Hands\-on, independent fluency with HubSpot (or equivalent CRM), Clay, and Apollo — able to operate and troubleshoot these from day one
* Track record building and defending pipeline forecasts and revenue dashboards
* Proven ability to drive process adoption in a sales org — not just design it
* Strong cross\-functional influence — comfortable changing team behavior without formal authority



  





**Core AI Skill Requirements:** 




 Securin is committed to becoming an AI\-native organization where GenAI is embedded into how every team works \- not just as an occasional assistant, but as a core part of delivery, operations, and how our expertise compounds over time. We expect every employee to actively integrate GenAI tools into daily workflows \- automating routine tasks, accelerating research and analysis, drafting documents, and building reusable AI\-powered processes for their function. You should understand the limitations of GenAI (including inaccuracies and data sensitivity boundaries), follow data classification rules, and continuously improve your AI proficiency. As you grow, we expect you to move beyond using GenAI to building with it \- designing agent workflows, contributing reusable skills, and helping Securin compound its Proactive Exposure Management expertise faster than any competitor can replicate.
 



  




* Demonstrated ability to use GenAI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) for daily work \- drafting, research, summarization, data analysis, code generation, or workflow automation as relevant to the Pro.
* Working knowledge of GenAI limitations including hallucination risk, context window constraints, and data sensitivity boundaries; ability to validate AI\-generated output before acting on it
* Familiarity with prompt engineering techniques \- structuring multi\-step instructions, providing context, and iterating on output quality to achieve production\-grade results
* Comfort with agentic AI workflows \- using, designing, or building multi\-step AI agents that execute tasks autonomously with human\-in\-the\-loop validation
* Awareness of AI security fundamentals \- prompt injection risks, data classification rules, sandboxed execution, and responsible handling of sensitive data in AI workflows
* Familiarity with connecting GenAI tools to internal data sources, APIs, and enterprise systems
* Ability to contribute reusable AI skills, templates, agent configurations, or automation workflows to a shared repository for team\-wide use
* Willingness to learn and adopt new AI tools as they evolve; participation in AI adoption sprints, hackathons, and knowledge\-sharing within the team



  





 If you meet the above requirements and are passionate about cybersecurity and providing excellent customer service, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
 



  





**Why should we connect?** 




 We are a bunch of passionate cybersecurity professionals who are building a culture of security. Today, cybersecurity is no more a luxury but a necessity with a global market value of $150 billion.
 



  





 At Securin, we live by a people\-first approach. We firmly believe that our employees should enjoy what they do. For our employees, we provide a hybrid work environment with competitive best\-in\-industry pay, while providing them with an environment to learn, thrive, and grow. Our hybrid working environment allows employees to work from the comfort of their homes or the office if they choose to. For the right candidate, this will feel like your second home.
 



  





 If you are passionate about cybersecurity just as we are, we would love to connect and share ideas.

title: Transformation Lead - AD
description:
**Role:** 
 Transformation Lead
   

  

**Business Vertical:** 
 IOA – Tech
   

  

**Role Summary**
 Hands\-on leader who acts as one of our most senior technical experts in the field. This is a unique, dual\-mission role. Externally, you will engage with our most strategic clients in a "forward\-deployed" capacity, leading technical workshops to design and integrate our data solutions into their complex ecosystems. Internally, you will use these client insights to architect and build the next generation of AI\-powered tools and workflows, radically optimizing our own data annotation processes. Your ultimate goal is to create an unbeatable competitive advantage by continuously improving our efficiency, quality, and delivery, directly reducing our clients' Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Client Solution Engineering \& Integration (External Focus)**
* Lead Technical Discovery \& Solution Design: Post\-sale, partner with the Solutioning team to lead deep\-dive technical workshops with clients. Deconstruct their current workflows, data challenges, and business objectives.
* Architect Custom Integration Plans: Design and map out how our platform and services will integrate seamlessly into the client's existing AI/ML pipelines and infrastructure.
* Act as the "Art of the Possible" Guide: Serve as the primary technical advisor to clients, demonstrating how our advanced capabilities, custom tools, and innovative workflows can solve their most difficult data challenges and accelerate their AI initiatives.
* Bridge to the Platform Team: Translate complex client requirements into precise technical specifications and user stories for our core Platform Deployment \& Management team, ensuring our platform roadmap is directly informed by real\-world client needs.
* Oversee Proofs of Concept (POCs): Lead and develop targeted POCs to prove the value and viability of our solutions within the client's environment, de\-risking large\-scale engagements.


**Internal Process Transformation \& Innovation (Internal Focus)**
* Drive Process Excellence: Be the owner of operational efficiency for our data annotation workforce. Continuously analyze our Human\-in\-the\-Loop (HITL) workflows to identify and eliminate bottlenecks.
* Develop AI\-Powered "Co\-Pilots" and Accelerators: Architect, build, and deploy a portfolio of internal tools and intelligent agents that augment our human annotators. This includes automated quality checks, predictive assistance, and workflow\-agnostic automation scripts.
* Engineer "Safety Nets": Design and implement automated quality assurance (QA) systems and predictive monitoring to ensure we consistently exceed client SLAs for accuracy and throughput.
* Champion Human\-in\-the\-Loop Optimization: Leverage Generative AI, LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), and computer vision models to create systems that make our human workforce smarter, faster, and more accurate.
* Quantify Business Impact: Develop and maintain a framework to measure the ROI of your transformation initiatives, clearly demonstrating their impact on project margins, delivery speed, and client TCO.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* Experience: 14\+ years in a technology field, with at least 5 years in a senior, client\-facing technical role such as a Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, Professional Services Consultant, or Transformation Lead.
* Applied AI \& Process Automation: Proven, hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-grade AI/ML systems specifically for process automation and optimization. This is more important than pure research experience.
* Generative AI Stack Expertise: Deep, practical experience with the modern Generative AI stack, including LLMs (fine\-tuning, RAG), agentic frameworks, and vector databases. You must have built things with these technologies.
* Hybrid Skillset: A demonstrated ability to operate at the intersection of deep technology and business strategy. You must be able to write code and architect systems, but also create a compelling business case and present to a client executive.
* Cloud Architecture: Deep architectural expertise in one or more major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including their managed AI/ML services (e.g., SageMaker, Vertex AI).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Consultative Mindset: A natural ability to listen, diagnose problems, and guide clients and internal teams toward elegant, effective solutions.
* Data Annotation Domain Knowledge: Direct experience with data annotation platforms, data quality challenges, and the operational dynamics of large\-scale data labeling workforces.
* Experience Building Internal Tools: A track record of identifying an internal business need and building a software solution to address it, driving measurable efficiency gains.
* An advanced degree (master's or PhD) in Computer Science, AI, or a related field is a strong plus.
* A portfolio of projects (e.g., GitHub) or detailed case studies demonstrating your work in building AI\-driven solutions.

**AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security – Manager**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security – Manager to act as the technical owner for client\-facing network \& Infrastructure Security transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a hands\-on manager who can move from discovery to design to deployment, embedding closely with clients to architect and implement high\-impact solutions while leading engineering teams and shaping deals. Your internal role matrix positions this level as the next step beyond just delivery, but architecting solutions at the intersection of platforms and AI tools (agents and models).
   

  

 This role is part of the Cyber Frontier \& AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI\-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443\-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Oversee deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE,DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Lead incident response and security improvement initiatives to enhance cyber resilience across hybrid infrastructure.
* Provide strategic guidance on secure remote access, DMZ architecture, PLC security, and cloud network protection.
* Design and implement AI\-assisted IT/OT security architecture and operations, enabling predictive threat monitoring and automated response within industrial environments.
* Develop and deploy AI\-driven anomaly detection models to identify deviations in OT network traffic, process behaviors, and industrial protocols (e.g., Modbus, DNP3, OPC).
* Build AI\-based rule optimization frameworks for IT/OT security controls, improving traffic filtering, segmentation policies, and alert accuracy.
* Leverage AI for OT network traffic optimization, enabling intelligent routing, congestion minimization, and adaptive policy enforcement.
* Implement AI\-powered device behavior profiling, establishing baselines for PLCs, HMIs, and IoT/IIoT assets to detect unauthorized or abnormal activities.
* Apply AI in PLC code analysis and review, identifying logic anomalies, misconfigurations, and potential security vulnerabilities in industrial control systems.
* Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero\-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI\-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network \& Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of experience across AI driven Network \& Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.
* Experience with OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
* Expertise in XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Strong capability in multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network \& infra structure security portfolio in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network \& infrastructure security practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.
   

  

 Typical work environment
   

  

* Global, cross\-functional teams
* Mix of advisory, architecture, engineering, and delivery
* Exposure to strategic client programs and market\-shaping offerings
* Opportunity to build reusable assets, accelerators, and modernization patterns consistent with a global delivery model

title: Innovation Manager
description:
**Job Description** 




 We invite you to join the ZEISS Innovation Hub Chennai to shape together with us the future of advanced frugal innovation. We are turning today’s research into tomorrow’s applications – together with academic partners, students and entrepreneurs. Located at the IIT Madras Research Park, you will work in direct neighborhood to a world\-leading universities and with many startups co\-located in this dynamic environment. You will:
 



 • Drive new topics under the umbrella of advanced frugal innovation, by identifying and evaluating opportunities in the innovation sweet spot of desirability, feasibility, and viability
 



 • Find and work with partners in these topics in close cooperation with ZEISS stakeholders
 



 • Conduct innovation and market studies, identify customer needs, and develop solution concepts as part of an interdisciplinary team
 



 • Initiate and steer projects (incl. external partners) in the development of novel solutions (e.g., proof\-of\-concept demonstrators) and ensure the transfer of relevant knowhow to ZEISS
 



 • Support the successful transfer of concepts, technologies, and solutions to ZEISS business units
 



 • Screen and evaluate startups with strategic relevance for the Inno Hub's topics
 



 • Develop new business and venturing proposals and ideally lead your topic through incubation with our internal venture unit
 



  





 ZEISS employees work in a place where expert knowledge and team spirit reign supreme. All of this is supported by a special ownership structure and the long\-term goal of the Carl Zeiss Foundation: to bring science and society into the future together.
 



  





**Job Requirements** 



1. Ideally looking for 8\-12 years of relevant experience, can extend to 17 years.
2. A university degree in Mechanical engineering, physics, material sciences, or other relevant STEM fields, ideally with a PhD/M. Tech
3. Good knowledge in Solid works/CAM/CAD.
4. Profound knowledge in mechanics (elasticity and plasticity), materials science, finite element modeling, manufacturing (additive and subtractive), and other relevant fields
5. Ideally experience in innovation management or (internal) venturing, relevant methodologies such as design thinking, business models, lean startup, and software’s such as Miro, Power BI, Sharp cloud etc. for visualizing idea funnels
6. An intrapreneurial mindset, a holistic view of innovation and a desire to take topics beyond technology to market success
7. Experience in project management
8. A “together we go far” (collaboration) and “just do it” (action\-bias) mindset
9. Passion for innovation and enthusiasm for new technologies as well as fun working in agile, interdisciplinary, and cross\-border teams
10. Ability to persevere in the process of idea creation and rejection, with a positive mindset

 Mercados Energy Markets India Pvt. Ltd. (Mercados) is a specialist consultancy firm, exclusively focused on business solutions in the energy and environment domain. Our approach integrates innovative, state\-of\-the\-art techniques with practical, tailor\-made solutions to solve current energy sector challenges. We have permanent offices in New Delhi (head office), Gurgaon, Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Pune and Lucknow. Mercados has presence across the Energy Value Chain and serves Clients both in the public and private domain. Mercados operates under two broad verticals, namely ‘Management Consulting’ and ‘Enterprise SaaS’. Our Consulting portfolio envelopes diverse segments like ‘Strategy and Business Growth’, ‘Policy, Economic Analysis and Regulations’, ‘Planning, Energy Markets \& Simulation Models’, ‘Transaction Advisory Services’, ‘Integrated Energy Supply Services’ and ‘Performance Improvement (Utility Management Services)’.

The role involves Business Development, selling Mercados' existing portfolio of solutions to new and existing clients, client leadership, team management, and quality assurance across projects, including bid process management for power procurement, evaluation of new initiatives, internal feasibility assessments, and preparation of concept notes and thought leadership papers. The AD/D is also expected to lead the development of high\-quality presentations for senior client leadership, conferences, webinars, and seminars.

* Drive business development in the Southern region, identifying new opportunities and building a strong pipeline of consulting mandates.
* Lead efforts to sell Mercados' existing portfolio of solutions and services to new and existing clients across the region.
* Lead and manage multiple ongoing and future consulting assignments in the power and renewable energy sector, ensuring timely delivery of high\-quality outputs.
* Provide strategic advisory on energy policies, regulations, incentives, and reforms related to power generation, power procurement, and renewable energy.
* Oversee bid process management assignments for procurement of power by distribution licensees.
* Lead analysis of policy and regulatory developments and assess their implications on client businesses, providing actionable recommendations.
* Act as the primary point of contact for clients in the Southern region, leading discussions, meetings, and stakeholder engagements.
* Mentor and guide team members, review their work, and ensure consistency, accuracy, and quality in deliverables.
* Coordinate closely with internal teams to manage project execution, resolve issues, and maintain delivery schedules.
* Lead preparation and presentation of concept notes, thought leadership papers, and client presentations for senior management forums.
* Represent the organization in client meetings, conferences, workshops, and industry events across the Southern region, as required.
* Foster a collaborative, high\-ownership team culture aligned with organizational goals.



  





**D. Required skill set:** 



* Proven track record in business development, client acquisition, and revenue growth within a consulting or advisory environment, ideally within the Southern region market.
* Demonstrated ability to sell a portfolio of consulting solutions to new and existing clients, and to build long\-term senior client relationships.
* Proven ability to lead multiple consulting engagements and manage complex assignments in a fast\-paced consulting environment.
* Strong understanding of the power sector value chain, with experience in at least two of the following areas — Power Markets, Power Distribution or Renewables— and the ability to translate this expertise into new business opportunities for the firm.
* Demonstrated experience working with a wide range of stakeholders, including Private, State, and Central Generators, Electricity Regulatory Commissions, Government bodies, and Power Utilities.
* Good understanding of the power sector landscape, including emerging policies and regulations, and their implications for clients.
* Excellent leadership, mentoring, and team management capabilities, with experience managing and growing consulting teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex concepts and thought leadership clearly to senior stakeholders.
* High level of analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making ability.
* Proven ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Proficiency in data analysis, reporting, and presentation tools (PowerPoint, Excel, etc.).
* Strong research orientation with the ability to translate insights into compelling client\-facing and thought leadership content.



  





**E. Education and Experience** 



* B.E/B. Tech or Equivalent with MBA in relevant field.

* We offer a motivation based and competitive reward package.

**Lindstrom Services India Private Limited** 




  





**Job Summary:** 




 As an
 **Account Manager at Lindström** 
 , you will be responsible for managing and developing an assigned portfolio of customers, with a focus on building long\-term relationships, delivering a strong customer experience and driving profitable business growth.
 



  





 Understanding customers' businesses, requirements and future needs, and work closely with internal teams to deliver relevant solutions. The role combines
 **customer relationship management, account development, commercial management and customer retention** 
 , with a clear focus on adding value and driving sustainable business growth.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Account Management \& Relationship Building** 



* Manage and develop an assigned portfolio of customers in line with business and customer objectives.
* Build trust through long\-term relationships with key customer stakeholders.
* Develop a good understanding of customers' businesses, processes, requirements and future priorities.
* Ensure regular engagement with customers and maintain a high level of customer satisfaction.



**2\. Business Growth** 



* Identify and develop opportunities for
 **up\-selling and cross\-selling** 
 across the customer portfolio.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend relevant Lindström products, services and solutions.
* Develop account plans to drive revenue growth and improve portfolio profitability.
* Proactively identify opportunities arising from changing customer needs and market developments.



**3\. Customer Retention \& Service Excellence** 



* Higher customer engagement and drive long\-term customer retention.
* Proactively identify customer concerns and coordinate with relevant teams for timely resolution.
* Work closely with Operations and Service teams to ensure consistent and effective service delivery.
* Monitor customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve the overall customer experience.



**4\. Commercial \& Contract Management** 



* Manage

 for the assigned portfolio.
* Lead customer discussions related to commercial proposals, renewals and account\-related matters.
* Monitor account performance, revenue and profitability and take appropriate actions where required.
* Ensure timely follow\-up and closure of commercial commitments and opportunities.



**5\. Cross\-functional Collaboration** 



* Work closely with
 **Sales, Operations, Service and other relevant teams** 
 to address customer requirements.
* Coordinate across functions to ensure a seamless and consistent customer experience.



**6\. Data, CRM \& Market Insights** 



* Use customer and sales data to monitor portfolio performance and identify opportunities and risks.
* Track relevant measures such as revenue, profitability, retention, customer satisfaction and sales effectiveness.
* Maintain accurate customer information, activities and opportunities in the CRM system.
* Develop awareness of market, industry and competitive developments relevant to the customer portfolio.



**7\. Operational Excellence \& Service Delivery** 



* **Oversee the operational delivery for assigned customers, ensuring agreed service standards, quality and timelines are consistently achieved.**
* Coordinate the team supporting the assigned customer portfolio, ensuring clear priorities, accountability and effective execution.
* Identify opportunities to improve
 **operational efficiency, service quality and customer experience** 
 .
* Proactively manage customer issues and escalations, ensuring timely resolution and effective communication.



  





**Key Requirements:** 




**Education \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales or a related discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.
* **3\-5 years of relevant experience** 
 in Account Management, Key Account Management, Customer Success, Relationship Management or Sales.
* **Willingness to travel** 
 regularly to customer locations and
 **work from customer sites** 
 as required by the role.
* Experience managing and developing an existing customer portfolio.
* Experience in customer retention, revenue growth, up\-selling, cross\-selling or contract renewals.
* Experience with CRM systems and working with customer or sales data.
* Exposure to commercial discussions or negotiations would be an advantage.
* Knowledge of the relevant market or industry would be an advantage.



**Skills \& Competencies:** 



* Strong relationship\-building and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Customer\-centric approach combined with sound commercial understanding.
* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Ability to understand customer needs and translate them into business opportunities.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to use data to support decisions.
* Strong ownership, planning and follow\-through.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with multiple internal teams.
* Proactive, solution\-oriented and adaptable approach.



  





**What Success Looks Like:** 




 Success in this role will be demonstrated through:
 


* Sustainable
 **revenue and profitability growth** 
 across the assigned portfolio.
* Strong customer relationships, satisfaction and retention.
* Operational Efficiency, and Service Quality
* Successful contract renewals and commercial outcomes.
* Growth through relevant
 **up\-selling and cross\-selling opportunities** 
 .
* Effective management and resolution of customer requirements.
* Strong collaboration with internal teams to deliver customer value.



  





**Why Join Lindström:** 




 At Lindström, you will have the opportunity to work closely with customers across diverse industries and play a meaningful role in developing long\-term partnerships.
 



 You will work in a collaborative environment where
 **customer focus, ownership, learning and continuous improvement** 
 are valued. The role provides opportunities to strengthen your commercial, consultative and relationship\-management capabilities while contributing directly to the growth of the business.
 



  





 As part of a global organisation with a strong commitment to sustainability, you will also be part of a business that aims to create lasting value for customers, people and the environment.

title: Supply Chain AI Solutions Architect
description:
Cognizant is looking to hire a Supply Chain AI Solutions Architect who will be part of the SCM AI practice within our Product Delivery Team (EPS). The role spans three areas: presales solutioning, running customer pilots in Supply Chain AI, and solutions architecture for new SC/AI offerings. You will work closely with Sales/BD, Functional SCM, and senior architecture reviewers to turn incoming requests into credible technical responses, then carry validated solutions through pilot delivery. A strong grasp of both AI\-based solutioning and traditional SCM technical architecture is needed, along with depth in at least one functional area of Supply Chain.
   

  

**What You'll Do \-**
 Presales
   

  

* Own first\-level technical solutioning for RFPs, RFIs, and SOWs \- AI/agentic solutions and traditional custom builds (integrations, data architecture)
* Map requests to existing solution patterns; escalate novel or complex asks to senior architecture review
* Provide effort sizing and feasibility calls under bid deadlines
* Draft technical solution sections of proposals \- architecture, differentiators, risks, dependencies
* Apply Cognizant pricing model with reuse in mind


 Customer Pilots
   

  

* Run customer pilots for SC AI solutions \- scoping, execution, and measurement against KPIs
* Act as technical point of contact through the pilot lifecycle, coordinating with client and internal teams
* Convert pilot outcomes into case studies and reusable proof points


 Solutions Architecture
   

  

* Design solution architecture for new SC/AI offerings \- data models, integration patterns, platform\-to\-play mapping
* Liaise with platform teams (Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Manhattan, SAP) on new capabilities
* Contribute to the SC AI play portfolio, keeping architecture reusable across clients


**Qualifications, Experience And Aptitude \-**
* 8\-12 years in SCM technology consulting, with presales/solution architecture exposure
* Hands\-on experience with both AI/agentic solutions and traditional integration/data builds
* Strength in one SC functional area (Planning/Forecasting, WMS, Order Management, Control Tower) plus working knowledge across the broader SC landscape
* Working knowledge preferred across any of: Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Manhattan, 09 (or similar)
* Life Sciences, Retail, or Manufacturing exposure preferred
* Familiarity with AI maturity frameworks a plus
* Strong communication skills \- clear technical writing under deadline pressure, confident client engagement during pilots
* Self\-driven, proactive and attention to detail necessary
* Based in India (Bangalore/Chennai preferred); limited travel for pilot engagements

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Deep expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 F\&SCM and AX 2012 across Finance and Supply Chain business processes.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

* Ability to conduct consultative conversations and demos confidently

* Proactive, adaptable, persistent, and target\-oriented mindset


**What Success Looks Like**

 • Proficiency in use of desktop software applications, such as MS office, LMS and CRM

* One life cycle project execution experience in recommending and/or implementing data strategy and solutions for improving business outcomes.
* Experience of being a data Product Owner and responsible for delivering product model and communicating the product needs with business partners.
* Exposure to working with non\-India Geographies (preferably the US) and / or interacting with Global stakeholders.


**Core Consulting**

* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members.
* Analytical thinking \- ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring \- structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems.
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused \- develop and own development of deliverables. own and manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources.
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate.
* Networking \- Ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.

title: Material Quotation Analyst
description:
Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market\-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. A career at Flex offers the opportunity to make a difference and invest in your growth in a respectful, inclusive, and collaborative environment. If you are excited about a role but don't meet every bullet point, we encourage you to apply and join us to create the extraordinary.
   

  

**Material Quotation Analyst I (G23\)**
**Position Summary**
 The Material Quotation Analyst is responsible for supporting Sales, Business Development, Supply Chain, and Customer Focus Teams by providing accurate and competitive material cost quotations. The role involves analyzing Bills of Materials (BOMs), sourcing component pricing, supporting RFQ activities, engaging with suppliers, and developing cost\-effective quotation packages that enhance customer satisfaction and drive business growth
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**RFQ \& Quotation Management**
* Process customer and internal RFQ requests within defined timelines.
* Prepare material cost estimates and quotation packages for new business opportunities.
* Support Business Development and Sales teams with competitive costing solutions.
* Ensure quotation data accuracy and completeness prior to submission.


**Cost Analysis \& Supplier Engagement**
* Source and identify the most cost\-effective suppliers and material solutions.
* Obtain supplier quotations and validate pricing against market benchmarks.
* Support cost\-reduction initiatives through alternate sourcing, redesign recommendations, and process substitution opportunities.
* Collaborate with Commodity Managers and Procurement teams to optimize material costs.


**BOM \& Data Management**
* Review and validate customer Bill of Materials (BOMs).
* Upload and maintain BOM information in quotation management systems.
* Verify AVL/AML compliance and component lifecycle status where applicable.
* Ensure data integrity within quotation and ERP tools


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Work closely with Sales, Program Management, Procurement, Engineering, and Supply Chain teams.
* Coordinate with suppliers and material groups to gather pricing, lead\-time, and availability information.
* Provide timely responses to customer and internal quotation\-related inquiries.


**Reporting \& Analytics**
* Generate quotation status, pricing, and cost analysis reports.
* Track RFQ performance metrics and maintain quotation databases.
* Support management reporting through data collection and analysis.


**Required Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, Operations, or related discipline.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.


**Experience**
* 3\+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Procurement, Costing, Quotation Management, or related functions.
* Experience in EMS, Manufacturing, Electronics, or Procurement environments is preferred.

description:

**EY\-Cyber Security\-IAM\- SailPoint ISC Senior**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
   

  

 In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
   

  

 As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* 3\-7 years of experience in designing and deploying ISC\-based Identity Governance and Administration solutions.
* Configure and manage SailPoint ISC tenant, including deployment of Virtual Appliances for secure connectivity between cloud and on\-premises environments
* Integrate of different auth sources and create identity profiles with transforms.
* Manage identity lifecycle through Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver processes.
* Develop workflows and custom forms for access requests and access review modules.
* Write and maintain Cloud Rules using Java/BeanShell for complex attribute transformations.
* Build and configure connectors for systems like Active Directory, Azure AD, Workday, Web Services, and JDBC.
* Work with SailPoint REST APIs for bulk operations, custom reporting, and external integrations (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow).
* Demonstrate strong understanding of JSON, XML, REST/SOAP, and SCIM protocols.
* Stay updated on latest ISC modules and functionalities such as AI and CIEM.
* Sailpoint engineer certification is preferred


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
